checks.name: request cancellation is isolated to its own lease
application stopping cancels every active terminal without waiting for ApplicationStopped
new requests cannot obtain a usable lease after stop or with an already-aborted request
stale release does not remove or cancel a later lease for the same device
user revocation and cabinet reclaim preserve unrelated leases
parallel acquire racing host shutdown never leaves a usable lease
setup access distinguishes local endpoints from remote LAN clients and unspecified addresses
unknown accounts and over-long passwords still perform one full hash verification

scope: In-process behavioral invariants with a fake IHostApplicationLifetime; no Windows service, HTTP listener or system configuration is started or changed. Does not replace SCM stop integration testing.
